newsitem.title: USA: Central Maine finds power plant interest.
newsitem.headline: Central Maine finds power plant interest.

text.p: Central Maine Power Co said Friday there is substantial interest in the utility's power plants, especially its hydro system.

The company said it sent requests for proposals Thursday to the parties who have expressed an interest in the utility's generating assets. The requests follow up on an information packet and proposed confidentiality agreement that sent to 153 parties June 5.
"This bid process will allow us to test how strong a market exists for the sale of these assets," the company said.
Under Maine's restructuring law, the power plants must be divested by March 1, 2000.
The company said it hired Dillon Read & Co Inc as financial advisor.
